title: Every classroom has all four elements
caption:
Every classroom has all four elements, and every teacher knows them by week two.

Air has a hand up before the question ends. Fire finished first and wants to know why the mark wasn't higher. Water does brilliant work, one day late. Earth says nothing and remembers everything.

One small change for each is on slide 6. Traditional temperament ideas as a lens, never a label.

Teachers: which element is your class? Tag a colleague from the staff room.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
